title: Use a storyboard reference image in Seedance 2.0 by specifying “Use @ Image1 as…
content:
Use a storyboard reference image in Seedance 2.0 by specifying “Use @ Image1 as storyboard reference” and explicitly mapping each video shot to a specific reference panel (e.g., “Shot 1 = reference panel 1”) to control content and style per shot.  
Prevent Seedance from outputting a collage/grid when the reference is multi-panel by adding a strict composition rule: “IGNORE the layout completely; output ONLY sequential full-screen VERTICAL video; show EXACTLY ONE scene at a time; NEVER display a grid/collage/split-screen/film strip.”  
Force vertical full-frame output by explicitly prompting “9:16 vertical, full-screen edge-to-edge, NO black bars, NO borders, NO dividing lines.”  
Ensure silent generations by adding an explicit “VIDEO ONLY with NO audio track” rule (no music, SFX, ambience, voice, dialogue).  
Maintain character consistency across shots by specifying “the SAME astronaut suit design throughout” (or equivalent consistent-asset constraint).  
Get smoother continuity by instructing “seamless natural morph transitions only (NO hard cuts)” and describing the end-of-shot morph into the next shot.  
Lock timing and cadence by specifying exact duration and fps (e.g., “exactly 15.0 seconds, 24fps”) and breaking the sequence into timed shot ranges (e.g., 0.0–2.5s, 2.5–5.0s, etc.).  
Improve camera control by describing per-shot camera motion explicitly (push-in, tracking behind, dolly-out, micro-orbit) and pairing it with scene motion cues (fog roll, dust motes, parallax, pulsing runes).  
Reinforce a consistent look by repeating global style constraints (e.g., “deep space-blue + luminous gold palette,” “volumetric lighting,” “photorealistic with digital-art enhancement,” “8K hyper-detailed”) and stating they apply “for EVERY frame.”  
Generate a multi-panel storyboard image first (e.g., with “GPT Image 2” and a 9-panel film strip prompt), then use that image as the Seedance storyboard reference for the prompt-to-video sequence.

es.content:
Usa una imagen de referencia de storyboard en Seedance 2.0 especificando “Use @ Image1 as storyboard reference” y asignando explícitamente cada plano del video a un panel de referencia específico (por ejemplo, “Shot 1 = reference panel 1”) para controlar el contenido y el estilo de cada plano.  
Evita que Seedance genere un collage/cuadrícula cuando la referencia tenga varios paneles añadiendo una regla estricta de composición: “IGNORE the layout completely; output ONLY sequential full-screen VERTICAL video; show EXACTLY ONE scene at a time; NEVER display a grid/collage/split-screen/film strip.”  
Fuerza una salida vertical a pantalla completa indicando explícitamente “9:16 vertical, full-screen edge-to-edge, NO black bars, NO borders, NO dividing lines.”  
Asegura generaciones sin sonido añadiendo una regla explícita de “VIDEO ONLY with NO audio track” (sin música, SFX, ambience, voice, dialogue).  
Mantén la consistencia del personaje entre planos especificando “the SAME astronaut suit design throughout” (o una restricción equivalente de activo consistente).  
Consigue una continuidad más fluida indicando “seamless natural morph transitions only (NO hard cuts)” y describiendo la morphing al final de cada plano hacia el siguiente.  
Bloquea el timing y el ritmo especificando la duración exacta y los fps (por ejemplo, “exactly 15.0 seconds, 24fps”) y dividiendo la secuencia en rangos de planos temporizados (por ejemplo, 0.0–2.5s, 2.5–5.0s, etc.).  
Mejora el control de cámara describiendo explícitamente el movimiento por plano (push-in, tracking behind, dolly-out, micro-orbit) y combinándolo con indicaciones de movimiento de la escena (fog roll, dust motes, parallax, pulsing runes).  
Refuerza un look consistente repitiendo restricciones globales de estilo (por ejemplo, “deep space-blue + luminous gold palette,” “volumetric lighting,” “photorealistic with digital-art enhancement,” “8K hyper-detailed”) y señalando que aplican “for EVERY frame.”  
Genera primero una imagen de storyboard multipanel (por ejemplo, con “GPT Image 2” y un prompt de film strip de 9 paneles), y luego usa esa imagen como referencia de storyboard de Seedance para la secuencia de prompt a video.

fr.content:
Utilisez une image de référence de storyboard dans Seedance 2.0 en spécifiant « Use @ Image1 as storyboard reference » et en associant explicitement chaque plan vidéo à un panneau de référence précis (par exemple, « Shot 1 = reference panel 1 ») afin de contrôler le contenu et le style plan par plan.  
Empêchez Seedance de produire un collage/grille lorsque la référence comporte plusieurs panneaux en ajoutant une règle de composition stricte : « IGNORE the layout completely; output ONLY sequential full-screen VERTICAL video; show EXACTLY ONE scene at a time; NEVER display a grid/collage/split-screen/film strip. »  
Forcez une sortie verticale plein cadre en demandant explicitement « 9:16 vertical, full-screen edge-to-edge, NO black bars, NO borders, NO dividing lines. »  
Assurez des générations silencieuses en ajoutant une règle explicite « VIDEO ONLY with NO audio track » (pas de musique, pas de SFX, pas d’ambiance, pas de voix, pas de dialogue).  
Maintenez la cohérence du personnage d’un plan à l’autre en précisant « the SAME astronaut suit design throughout » (ou une contrainte équivalente de cohérence des assets).  
Obtenez une continuité plus fluide en indiquant « seamless natural morph transitions only (NO hard cuts) » et en décrivant la morphose de fin de plan vers le plan suivant.  
Verrouillez le timing et le rythme en précisant la durée exacte et le fps (par exemple, « exactly 15.0 seconds, 24fps ») et en découpant la séquence en plages de plans horodatées (par exemple, 0.0–2.5s, 2.5–5.0s, etc.).  
Améliorez le contrôle de la caméra en décrivant explicitement le mouvement de caméra pour chaque plan (push-in, tracking behind, dolly-out, micro-orbit) et en l’associant à des indices de mouvement de la scène (fog roll, dust motes, parallax, pulsing runes).  
Renforcez un rendu cohérent en répétant les contraintes globales de style (par exemple, « deep space-blue + luminous gold palette », « volumetric lighting », « photorealistic with digital-art enhancement », « 8K hyper-detailed ») et en précisant qu’elles s’appliquent « for EVERY frame ».  
Générez d’abord une image de storyboard multi-panneaux (par exemple, avec « GPT Image 2 » et un prompt de film strip à 9 panneaux), puis utilisez cette image comme référence de storyboard Seedance pour la séquence prompt-to-video.

ja.content:
Seedance 2.0 でストーリーボード参照画像を使うには、“Use @ Image1 as storyboard reference” と指定し、各動画ショットを特定の参照パネルに明示的に対応付けます（例：“Shot 1 = reference panel 1”）。これにより、ショットごとの内容とスタイルを制御できます。  
参照画像が複数パネルの場合に Seedance がコラージュ／グリッドを出力しないようにするには、厳格な構図ルールを追加します：“IGNORE the layout completely; output ONLY sequential full-screen VERTICAL video; show EXACTLY ONE scene at a time; NEVER display a grid/collage/split-screen/film strip.”  
縦長のフルフレーム出力を強制するには、“9:16 vertical, full-screen edge-to-edge, NO black bars, NO borders, NO dividing lines.” と明示的にプロンプトします。  
無音生成を確実にするには、“VIDEO ONLY with NO audio track” という明示的なルールを追加します（音楽、SFX、アンビエンス、ボイス、会話はすべてなし）。  
ショット間でキャラクターの一貫性を保つには、“the SAME astronaut suit design throughout” のように指定します（または同等の一貫したアセット制約）。  
より滑らかな連続性を得るには、“seamless natural morph transitions only (NO hard cuts)” と指示し、各ショットの終わりが次のショットへモーフする様子を記述します。  
タイミングとテンポを固定するには、正確な尺と fps を指定し（例：“exactly 15.0 seconds, 24fps”）、シーケンスを時間範囲ごとのショットに分割します（例：0.0–2.5s、2.5–5.0s など）。  
カメラ制御を改善するには、ショットごとのカメラ移動を明示的に記述し（push-in、tracking behind、dolly-out、micro-orbit など）、それをシーンの動きの手がかり（fog roll、dust motes、parallax、pulsing runes など）と組み合わせます。  
一貫した見た目を強化するには、グローバルなスタイル制約を繰り返し（例：“deep space-blue + luminous gold palette,” “volumetric lighting,” “photorealistic with digital-art enhancement,” “8K hyper-detailed”）、それらが“for EVERY frame” に適用されると明記します。  
まずマルチパネルのストーリーボード画像を生成し（例：“GPT Image 2” と 9-panel film strip prompt を使用）、その画像を Seedance のストーリーボード参照として使って、prompt-to-video のシーケンスを作成します。

ko.content:
Seedance 2.0에서 스토리보드 참조 이미지를 사용하려면 “Use @ Image1 as storyboard reference”라고 지정하고, 각 비디오 샷을 특정 참조 패널에 명시적으로 매핑하세요(예: “Shot 1 = reference panel 1”). 이렇게 하면 샷별로 콘텐츠와 스타일을 제어할 수 있습니다.  
참조가 멀티패널일 때 Seedance가 콜라주/그리드 형태로 출력하는 것을 방지하려면 엄격한 구성 규칙을 추가하세요: “IGNORE the layout completely; output ONLY sequential full-screen VERTICAL video; show EXACTLY ONE scene at a time; NEVER display a grid/collage/split-screen/film strip.”  
세로 풀프레임 출력을 강제하려면 “9:16 vertical, full-screen edge-to-edge, NO black bars, NO borders, NO dividing lines.”라고 명시적으로 프롬프트하세요.  
무음 생성을 보장하려면 “VIDEO ONLY with NO audio track” 규칙을 명확히 추가하세요(음악, SFX, 앰비언스, 보이스, 대사 없음).  
샷 간 캐릭터 일관성을 유지하려면 “the SAME astronaut suit design throughout”처럼 동일한 에셋 유지 제약을 지정하세요.  
더 부드러운 연속성을 얻으려면 “seamless natural morph transitions only (NO hard cuts)”라고 지시하고, 한 샷의 끝이 다음 샷으로 자연스럽게 변형되도록 설명하세요.  
정확한 지속 시간과 fps를 지정하고(예: “exactly 15.0 seconds, 24fps”), 시퀀스를 시간대별 샷 범위로 나누어(예: 0.0–2.5s, 2.5–5.0s 등) 타이밍과 리듬을 고정하세요.  
카메라 제어를 개선하려면 샷별 카메라 움직임을 명시적으로 설명하고(push-in, tracking behind, dolly-out, micro-orbit), 이를 장면의 움직임 단서(fog roll, dust motes, parallax, pulsing runes)와 함께 짝지으세요.  
일관된 룩을 강화하려면 전역 스타일 제약을 반복해서 언급하세요(예: “deep space-blue + luminous gold palette,” “volumetric lighting,” “photorealistic with digital-art enhancement,” “8K hyper-detailed”) 그리고 이것들이 “for EVERY frame”에 적용된다고 명시하세요.  
먼저 멀티패널 스토리보드 이미지를 생성한 다음(예: “GPT Image 2”와 9패널 film strip 프롬프트 사용), 그 이미지를 Seedance 스토리보드 참조로 사용해 prompt-to-video 시퀀스를 만드세요.

pt.content:
Use uma imagem de referência de storyboard no Seedance 2.0 especificando “Use @ Image1 as storyboard reference” e mapeando explicitamente cada tomada do vídeo para um painel de referência específico (por exemplo, “Shot 1 = reference panel 1”) para controlar o conteúdo e o estilo por tomada.  
Impeça o Seedance de gerar uma colagem/grade quando a referência tiver vários painéis adicionando uma regra rígida de composição: “IGNORE the layout completely; output ONLY sequential full-screen VERTICAL video; show EXACTLY ONE scene at a time; NEVER display a grid/collage/split-screen/film strip.”  
Force a saída vertical em tela cheia promptando explicitamente “9:16 vertical, full-screen edge-to-edge, NO black bars, NO borders, NO dividing lines.”  
Garanta gerações sem áudio adicionando uma regra explícita de “VIDEO ONLY with NO audio track” (sem música, SFX, ambience, voice, dialogue).  
Mantenha a consistência do personagem entre as tomadas especificando “the SAME astronaut suit design throughout” (ou uma restrição equivalente de asset consistente).  
Obtenha uma continuidade mais suave instruindo “seamless natural morph transitions only (NO hard cuts)” e descrevendo a morphing do fim de uma tomada para a próxima.  
Trave o timing e o ritmo especificando duração e fps exatos (por exemplo, “exactly 15.0 seconds, 24fps”) e dividindo a sequência em intervalos de tomadas com tempo definido (por exemplo, 0.0–2.5s, 2.5–5.0s, etc.).  
Melhore o controle de câmera descrevendo explicitamente o movimento de câmera por tomada (push-in, tracking behind, dolly-out, micro-orbit) e combinando isso com pistas de movimento da cena (fog roll, dust motes, parallax, pulsing runes).  
Reforce um visual consistente repetindo restrições globais de estilo (por exemplo, “deep space-blue + luminous gold palette,” “volumetric lighting,” “photorealistic with digital-art enhancement,” “8K hyper-detailed”) e afirmando que elas se aplicam “for EVERY frame.”  
Gere primeiro uma imagem de storyboard com vários painéis (por exemplo, com “GPT Image 2” e um prompt de film strip de 9 painéis) e, depois, use essa imagem como referência de storyboard do Seedance para a sequência prompt-to-video.

zh.content:
在 Seedance 2.0 中使用分镜参考图时，可通过指定“Use @ Image1 as storyboard reference”，并将每个视频镜头明确映射到对应的参考面板（例如，“Shot 1 = reference panel 1”），以按镜头控制内容和风格。  
如果参考图是多面板的，为防止 Seedance 输出拼贴/网格，可添加严格的构图规则：“IGNORE the layout completely; output ONLY sequential full-screen VERTICAL video; show EXACTLY ONE scene at a time; NEVER display a grid/collage/split-screen/film strip.”  
通过明确提示“9:16 vertical, full-screen edge-to-edge, NO black bars, NO borders, NO dividing lines.”，强制输出竖屏全画幅。  
通过添加明确的“VIDEO ONLY with NO audio track”规则（不含音乐、SFX、环境音、旁白、对白），确保生成内容无声。  
通过指定“the SAME astronaut suit design throughout”（或等效的统一资产约束），保持各镜头中的角色一致性。  
通过指示“seamless natural morph transitions only (NO hard cuts)”并描述镜头末尾如何变形过渡到下一个镜头，可获得更平滑的连续性。  
通过指定精确时长和 fps（例如，“exactly 15.0 seconds, 24fps”），并将序列拆分为带时间范围的镜头段（例如，0.0–2.5s、2.5–5.0s 等），锁定节奏与时序。  
通过明确描述每个镜头的运镜方式（push-in、tracking behind、dolly-out、micro-orbit）并配合场景运动提示（fog roll、dust motes、parallax、pulsing runes），提升镜头控制。  
通过重复全局风格约束（例如，“deep space-blue + luminous gold palette”、“volumetric lighting”、“photorealistic with digital-art enhancement”、“8K hyper-detailed”），并声明它们适用于“for EVERY frame”，强化统一视觉效果。  
先生成一张多面板分镜图（例如使用“GPT Image 2”和 9-panel film strip prompt），然后将该图作为 Seedance 的分镜参考，用于 prompt-to-video 序列。
